items.name: Jie Fan
items.introduction: Prof. Jie Fan of Nankai University serves as the principal investigator of our team, providing scientific vision and strategic guidance throughout the project. Her research centers on microbial secondary metabolism, chemical interactions between species, and synthetic biology-based construction of microbial chassis. She helps the team translate biological questions into feasible engineering strategies and keeps experimental design, data analysis, and project communication closely aligned.

items.name: Peng-Lin Wei
items.introduction: Dr. Peng-Lin Wei is a postdoctoral researcher at Nankai University whose research focuses on engineering filamentous fungal cell factories for secondary metabolite production. As our team’s advisor, he provides guidance on both dry-lab and wet-lab research, helping us refine research ideas and strengthen experimental design.

items.name: Churchill Zhu
items.introduction: Churchill Zhu led NKU-China 2025 through the full iGEM season last year. This year, he has returned as an advisor, standing one step behind the team instead of at the front. Still a Dionysus in human form—warm, open, always up for a genuine conversation, and forever ready to help. His reverence for life hasn’t changed, nor has his belief that studying it pushes the frontier of human knowledge and feeds the flame of civilization. This year, he is helping a new crew push it a little further—passing on what last season taught him and learning from them in return.

items.name: Roy Zhang
items.introduction: Roy Zhang coordinates our team’s dry-lab work, with a particular focus on molecular dynamics simulations and molecular docking. He provides guidance on the overall direction of dry-lab research, helping us refine computational strategies and address challenges in modeling and analysis.

items.name: Fu Xinya
items.introduction: Hello, I'm Fu Xinya. I enjoy hiking and reading, and I make time for both outdoor adventures and quiet moments with a book. I'm meticulous, resilient, and responsible in my approach to everyday challenges. My favourite snacks are yogurt and dried cranberries, and if I had to pick an animal to represent me, it would be the red panda.

items.name: Yang Ruoxi
items.introduction: I'm Yang Ruoxi. I love art, music, and film, and I enjoy exploring different forms of expression. I sometimes spend my free time analyzing lyrics and reading horoscopes, and I'm interested in astrology. These interests offer a glimpse into what catches my attention outside my academic work.

items.name: Zhang Hongbo
items.introduction: I'm Zhang Hongbo, a first-year Ph.D. student. This is my second time participating in iGEM, which has given me valuable experience in early-stage project design and teamwork. I love playing volleyball and growing plants, hobbies that cultivate my patience and team spirit. I am highly collaborative and proactive. During the early stages of the competition, I actively engaged in multiple discussions to determine the project topic and specific experimental directions.

items.name: Wang Chang
items.introduction: I’m Wang Chang, a nature enthusiast and an avid arthropod fan! My thoughts leap from one idea to another, and I’m full of unpredictable bursts of passion and a dash of good humour. I enjoy drawing, reading books, and rolling d20s down in the dungeons. Occasionally, I wish I could be a moth.

items.name: Liu Yifei
items.introduction: Hello, I'm Liu Yifei, but you can also call me Ivy. I enjoy sports, travelling, and meeting new people. I'm open-minded and energetic, and I love exploring unfamiliar places and making new connections. An energy bar and orange juice are my go-to snacks.

items.name: Kuang Yinzi
items.introduction: I'm Kuang Yinzi. I'm introverted and slow to warm up, but I become easygoing once I'm comfortable. My biggest hobby is playing video games. In sports, I like table tennis and badminton, enjoying the focused, back-and-forth rhythm of a match. When relaxing, I also listen to music and scroll through short videos. I'm also interested in synthetic biology, drawn to the combination of biology and engineering, and hope to learn more about it in the future.

items.name: Luo Yuanwen
items.introduction: I enjoy making crafts and trying different foods. Curious and attentive to detail, I like learning new things and working with others. My hobbies give me the chance to create something by hand and discover something new.

items.name: Wang Qinghua
items.introduction: I'm Wang Qinghua. I love wandering outdoors and observing tiny creatures that are easy to overlook. I find beauty in living things and am endlessly curious about the natural world. I'm warm and proactive, and I enjoy exploring my surroundings. Lemon candy and oolong tea are among my favourite treats.

items.name: Zheng Shizhao
items.introduction: Zheng Shizhao is a well‑rounded cross‑discipline talent with Schrödinger‑like energy levels. He plays football, table tennis, roller skating and volleyball, a seasoned football veteran with decent skills. He enjoys erhu and diverse music styles, and is lately hooked on old Cantonese songs. An ambivert brimming with quirky ideas, he brings both surprises and occasional headaches to the team.

items.name: Peng Ziyi
items.introduction: Hello, I'm Ziyi Peng, a 2024 Biological Sciences Boling Class student at Nankai University. Beyond my passion for biology, I'm a Minecraft enthusiast actively building our campus MC club, a sweet tooth, and a music lover who enjoys playing various instruments. Excited to join iGEM and connect with fellow science enthusiasts!

items.name: Chen Feiyue
items.introduction: I enjoy playing basketball and exploring open-source tools. Patient and attentive to detail, I like working through questions carefully and discovering how things work. Dark chocolate and black coffee are my favourite companions, and if I had to choose an animal to represent me, it would be the owl.

items.name: Huang Xinqi
items.introduction: I enjoy reading novels and jogging, making time for both imagined worlds and the outdoors. Calm and thoughtful, I value the friendships I've formed with my teammates. Milk tea and mixed nuts are my go-to treats, and I identify with the sea turtle.

items.name: Song Yanmei
items.introduction: I enjoy science-fiction films and expressing imaginative ideas through painting. My interest in science goes hand in hand with my love of art, giving me different ways to explore what intrigues me. I'm analytical and creative, and I enjoy working with others.

items.name: Ye Shulan
items.introduction: I've loved volleyball for a long time and wish I had more chances to get on the court. I'm also a big foodie and an avid city walker, always happy to discover a new street or something delicious. My favourite snack is potato chips, and I haven't decided on an animal to represent me yet.

items.name: Guan Zhiyuan
items.introduction: Hi everyone, I’m Guan Zhiyuan! I enjoy exploring unfamiliar things and trying something new. I also love a good book, especially psychology books and novels. I have plenty of hobbies, though I’m more of a curious beginner than an expert in any of them.

items.name: Ma Peisong
items.introduction: I’m the Human Practices captain of NKU-iGEM and a master’s student in Biology and Medicine at Nankai University. Drawing on my academic background, I work to connect our research with societal needs and encourage dialogue between the team and the wider community.

items.name: Song Xinying
items.introduction: I'm Song Xinying. I'm equally passionate about biology and art, and that passion is what brought me to this team. In my daily life, I enjoy a range of hobbies such as writing, photography, and listening to music. Though I may seem introverted at first, I have a rich inner world and look forward to meeting people from different backgrounds.

items.name: Chen Yuxin
items.introduction: For me, music and visuals are closely connected. I love anime music, enjoy singing, and often spend my free time creating MAD edits in Adobe After Effects. I'm gentle and optimistic, and I enjoy capturing moments and expressing my ideas through visual storytelling.

items.name: Chen Jiarui
items.introduction: I'm Chen Jiarui, a computer science student and a self-described night owl. I enjoy experimenting with AI tools and playing Valorant, and I joke that waking up is much harder than falling asleep. My favourite snack is salted chips, and if I had to choose an animal to represent me, it would be a dog.

items.name: Kaiben Zhang
items.introduction: I'm Zhang Kaiben. I'm optimistic and enthusiastic about volunteering. I enjoy meeting people, bringing them together, and taking part in activities that connect me with the broader community. My curiosity and interest in sharing science draw me to conversations with people of different ages and backgrounds.

items.name: Han Xinyu
items.introduction: As a creative team member working on Human Practices and visual design, I enjoy illustration, exploring nature, and crafting in my spare time. I specialize in turning complex scientific concepts into intuitive visuals and accessible science communication. Detail-oriented, I create engaging outreach materials that connect research with the public. Ultimately, I hope to make science more approachable to everyone.

items.name: Bai Ruitong
items.introduction: I’m Blinda, an undergraduate student in Visual Communication Design. I enjoy getting lost in words and films—or simply letting my mind wander. Patient and approachable, I enjoy exchanging ideas with others and exploring different ways to express them. My imagination often takes me in unexpected directions, while my attention to detail helps me give those ideas a clear visual form.

items.name: Chen Yiling
items.introduction: As a Digital Interaction major, I enjoy exploring how visuals and interactive experiences shape the way people connect with ideas. I am attentive to detail and thoughtful in my approach, while bringing enthusiasm and creative energy to collaborative work. Curious about fields beyond design, I welcome opportunities to learn from people with different backgrounds and explore new ways to express ideas.
